content: Axios/fetch interceptor pattern for refresh: use an isRefreshing boolean + failedQueue array. On 401, if not already refreshing, start refresh and set flag; other concurrent 401s push their original request config onto the queue instead of calling refresh. On refresh success, drain queue and retry each with new token; on failure, reject queue and force logout. Mark retried requests with a _retry flag to avoid infinite retry loops. Prefer httpOnly cookies over localStorage for token storage where feasible.
